items.title: Call for Applications: Global EbA Fund For MSMEs (Up to $500,000)
items.one_liner: A funding call offers up to $500,000 in grants through the Global EbA Fund for MSMEs.
items.why: Connects ecosystem-based adaptation finance with practical implementation opportunities for urban green-blue infrastructure.

items.title: Youth climate fund: Tauranga among 300 cities chosen for funding
items.one_liner: Tauranga was selected alongside 300 cities to receive funding from a youth climate fund.
items.why: Demonstrates municipal-level financial instruments supporting local climate and youth-led urban resilience initiatives.
items.action: Explore which urban sectors and interventions are prioritized by the youth climate fund.

items.title: Costa Mesa Leaders Approve City’s First Climate Action Plan
items.one_liner: Costa Mesa leaders approved the city's first Climate Action Plan.
items.why: Provides a practical reference for local climate planning, mitigation targets, and municipal policy integration.
items.action: Review the plan for climate adaptation strategies relevant to urban heat or green space goals.

items.title: COP31 opens in Türkiye with push to turn climate pledges into action
items.one_liner: COP31 opened in Antalya, Turkey, focusing on translating climate pledges into concrete action.
items.why: Highlights international policy directions regarding climate finance, adaptation, and global environmental governance.
items.action: Track COP31 outcomes and announcements related to urban adaptation and climate finance mechanisms.

items.title: Let’s Grow partnership to create green links in Perth and Peel
items.one_liner: A new partnership was launched to create green links and protect wildlife habitats in Perth and Peel.
items.why: Offers a real-world case of landscape configuration and habitat quality enhancement in urban environments.
items.action: Examine the partnership's spatial strategy for connecting fragmented urban habitats.

items.title: Groups propose using nature to relieve 7th Ward flooding in New Orleans
items.one_liner: Community groups proposed nature-based solutions to mitigate urban flooding in the 7th Ward.
items.why: Directly relates to stormwater runoff retention, urban ecosystem services, and local community-based planning.
items.action: Read the proposal to see how nature-based interventions are modeled for flood mitigation.
